verdict.rationale: Community reports describe a welcome or starter board that walks new users through Trello. One user said it "taught everything in 2 minutes" (trello-comm-18); another found it intuitive but wanted voting explained on the welcome board (trello-comm-13). First-party templates offer a starting blueprint (trello-docs-5). missing for 10: first-party documentation of a guided first-run workspace setup flow, step-by-step walkthrough evidence beyond old community anecdotes, and engineer-specific workspace onboarding.
